summary.note: A phase swap changes every later decision, so a win gap is not the effect of one choice. 8401-8402 reproduces the saved baseline and is not a new validation set. Hidden deck order is not read to choose an action. Belief worlds keep search seed 1. connecting counts a life drop only before the next attack is declared, so life change is the damage measure.

answers.improvesMostOften: idle main. 14-10, twelve gains and no losses against v3. Paired +0.50 [0.333, 0.667]. Raids +2.29 per game, declared attacks +1.12, opponent life -3.08. Not a causal claim.
answers.worsens: pending. 0-24, the two v3 wins become losses. Paired -0.083 [-0.208, 0], includes 0. One lost win is a searched block that hard passes.
answers.start: 8-16, six gains, no losses, +0.25 [0.125, 0.375]. 23 of 24 first differences are extraDraw to next, and both actions were in the beam. That is the draw choice already measured by reserveAp.
answers.hardReference: 12-12 when both seats are hard. Replacing every phase is a smaller gain than replacing only main, because hard pending play gives wins back.

mechanism.notDepth: At the representative main win both energy plays had already spent 16 nodes and reached a boundary.

conclusion.nextExperiment: Default off, not added. On an idle main decision, an energy play that was executed and reached a later phase is not replaced by an earlier-phase front of another card, and the generator does not turn that front into the other card. No score weights, no card-number exception. It has to be paired on a fresh set. This 24-game gap is the exposed diagnostic set.
